selected_route.title: Record grades and test separate PE ratios
selected_route.change: Adjust recycled-to-virgin PE proportion across separate recorded trials, holding preparation constant.
selected_route.why: Changing only the PE ratio while holding preparation constant may show the direction of yield shift in your resins, so measurement can guide the next choice.
selected_route.check: Moulded specimens tested for tensile yield stress at least 25 MPa, using a stated specimen and method; compare to this screen without transferring published specimen values to your resin.
steps: Record identified PCRPE and virgin MDPE grades, lot IDs and current proportion on a mass-percent basis; blank amounts stay unknown.
Choose two or three clearly separated mass-percent levels as adjustable starting choices.
At a suitable facility, mould specimens for each level under a recorded process; facility and tester unconfirmed.
Test each level separately from sleeve fit checks and use the measurement to select a ratio to carry forward.
tradeoffs: Higher recycled share may bring more lot variation and need stricter sorting.
Higher virgin share may lower recycled use and raise material cost.
Extra levels need more facility time and specimens.

selected_trial.title: Two-ratio PE screen for 25 MPa threshold
selected_trial.objective: Find which recorded PE-ratio direction moves tensile yield in your resins toward the chosen screen, without transferring published values to your resin and without using the screen as a planter requirement. Moulding and testing are conditional on a suitable facility.
selected_trial.comparison: Level A versus Level B: two adjustable mass-percent choices with clearly separated recycled share, same identified PCRPE lot, same virgin MDPE lot, same recorded preparation, same facility process, same specimen and test method. Only the recycled-to-virgin proportion changes.
selected_trial.change: Compare two clearly separated recycled-to-virgin PE mass-percent levels in separate recorded specimen trials, holding preparation and moulding process constant within the comparison.
keep_fixed: Same identified PCRPE lot and same identified virgin MDPE lot for both levels.
Same recorded preparation, sorting and moisture handling for both levels.
Same facility moulding process and same stated specimen and tensile method for both levels.
Separate liner supports soil and water; material screen kept separate from sleeve fit, creep and weathering decisions.

steps.action: At home, record the identified PCRPE grade and lot ID and the virgin MDPE grade and lot ID on a mass-percent basis; leave blank amounts unknown.
steps.record: Grades, lot IDs, supply lots and current proportion basis; note moisture, contamination and lot differences as uncharacterized.

steps.action: Choose two clearly separated mass-percent levels as adjustable starting choices and label them Level A and Level B without treating either choice as an optimum.
steps.record: Chosen Level A and Level B definitions, mass-percent basis and reason for separation.

steps.action: Confirm a suitable facility with appropriate PE moulding capability, tooling, extraction and tensile-testing capability before any heated processing or testing; do not process resin at home.
steps.record: Facility name, confirmed capabilities, recorded moulding process and stated specimen and test method to be used.

steps.action: At that suitable facility only, mould specimens for Level A and Level B under the same recorded process, keeping preparation constant.
steps.record: Process record per level, specimen count and identity, preparation record and any processing observations per level.

steps.action: Test Level A and Level B separately for the screen and use the measured direction to choose one ratio to carry forward, keeping sleeve-fit checks separate.
steps.record: Yield result per level with specimen and method stated, ratio carried forward, and separate sleeve-fit notes unchanged by this screen.

checks.target: tensile yield stress at least 25 MPa, using a stated specimen and method.
checks.method: Mould specimens for each PE ratio at a suitable facility under one recorded process, then test each ratio separately with a stated specimen geometry and tensile method recorded with the result. Home planning alone cannot establish this property.
checks.if_outside: If below the screen, record the direction of shift and run a new one-variable comparison, for example a further adjustment to the mass-percent choice or a separate preparation comparison; do not carry an unmeasured level forward as selected.

checks.method: Separate fit and clearance planning around the existing watertight liner using recorded dimensions; no tensile result and no published specimen value proves sleeve fit.
checks.if_outside: Keep sleeve-fit planning separate from the material screen; adjust sleeve geometry or liner clearance in a separate comparison if fit is an issue, without changing the PE-ratio conclusion.

checks.method: Record lot IDs, visual condition, sorting/preparation notes and any facility processing notes separately for each level; short exposure or visual checks do not establish weathering or creep.
checks.if_outside: If sorting, moisture, odour, gels, discolouration or moulding notes differ between lots, hold the ratio comparison and make contamination or drying the subject of a separate recorded preparation comparison.

questions: What are the exact PCRPE and virgin MDPE grades, lot IDs and current mass-percent proportion?
What suitable facility with confirmed PE moulding and tensile-testing capability can record process, specimen and method?
Is the sleeve geometry and outdoor exposure still open enough to keep fit and weathering as separate later checks?

warnings: Synthetic simulation: these entries are not physical measurements.
These comparisons describe only the readings and settings entered; they do not predict another setting or future production.
The result compares reported values only. Measurement uncertainty is not modeled and a value inside the target is not product qualification.
The entered target and units are used as stated; they are not converted or checked against other target text in the shared case.

Grouping labels, kinds and separate reading/specimen/run/batch/repeat-of identifiers are user supplied and retained. Their hierarchy, references and statistical independence are not assessed; only readings are counted.
The comparison does not establish causation, physical performance of an untested configuration, or consistency across batches.
No values are interpolated, averaged, pooled from studies, or copied from stored source data.
